# PulseEngine

> Formally verified WebAssembly Component Model engine for safety-critical
> systems. An ecosystem of 30+ repositories covering static fusion, verified
> optimization, supply chain attestation, requirements traceability, architecture
> analysis, and formal verification — all in Rust.

PulseEngine is under active development. All tools are pre-1.0.

## Docs

- [Formal Verification Guide](https://pulseengine.eu/guides/VERIFICATION-GUIDE.md): Verus, Rocq, Lean, Kani patterns — Rust subset intersection, proof tactics, error classification, Bazel rules

## Core Pipeline

- [meld](https://github.com/pulseengine/meld): Statically fuses multiple WebAssembly components into a single core module
- [loom](https://github.com/pulseengine/loom): Twelve-pass WebAssembly optimizer built on Cranelift ISLE
- [synth](https://github.com/pulseengine/synth): Transcodes WebAssembly to native ARM via program synthesis
- [kiln](https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln): WebAssembly Component Model interpreter with WASI 0.2 and no_std

## Safety-Critical Tools

- [rivet](https://github.com/pulseengine/rivet): Schema-driven SDLC artifact manager — ISO 26262, ASPICE, DO-178C, IEC 61508, EU AI Act, SOTIF
- [spar](https://github.com/pulseengine/spar): AADL v2.2 architecture analysis — 30+ pluggable analyses, LSP, SVG rendering
- [gale](https://github.com/pulseengine/gale): Formally verified Rust port of Zephyr RTOS kernel primitives targeting ASIL-D

## Security

- [sigil](https://github.com/pulseengine/sigil): WebAssembly code signing — Sigstore keyless, Ed25519, embedded signatures, offline verify

## Build Rules

- [rules_wasm_component](https://github.com/pulseengine/rules_wasm_component): Bazel rules for Component Model (Rust, Go, C++, JS) — v1.0
- [rules_verus](https://github.com/pulseengine/rules_verus): Bazel rules for Verus verification
- [rules_rocq_rust](https://github.com/pulseengine/rules_rocq_rust): Bazel rules for Rocq theorem proving
- [rules_lean](https://github.com/pulseengine/rules_lean): Bazel rules for Lean 4 with Mathlib

## Governance

- [temper](https://github.com/pulseengine/temper): GitHub App that hardens repositories to organizational standards

## Compliance Reports

- [Reports](https://pulseengine.eu/reports/): Versioned compliance reports generated by rivet on every release
